title: Catervas RPC
description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 text frames between the browser and the daemon's GET /rpc (docs/SPEC.md section 8). Any frame is a request, a response, or a notification; the query results and the command reply are $defs, which name the shape of each answer. command and event are objects here, not references, because one schema never references another: command_from_value and event_from_value read them.

requestId.description: The caller's own number for a request, echoed by its response.

command.description: A command wire of command.schema.json; the daemon validates it with command_from_value.

rpcRequest.title: Rpc Request
rpcRequest.description: What the browser sends. The pairing of a query's name with its params is the schema's; the meaning of a command is command_from_value's.

result.description: emptyResult for subscribe and unsubscribe, commandReply for command, the query's own result def for query, and the method's own result def (projectOpenResult, projectCreateResult, which project.create_folder answers too, accountConnectResult, sandboxBuildResult, browserPullResult) for a setup method, and each other method's own result def.

id.description: null when the request's id could not be read.

rpcError.title: Rpc Error
rpcError.description: -32700 parse, -32600 invalid request, -32601 unknown method, -32602 invalid params, -32603 internal (the store or a file failed), -32001 unknown_query, -32002 not_found, -32003 refused_here, -32004 no_project (the daemon has no project yet, so it answers only the setup queries), -32005 refused (a setup method was refused; the message is the sentence to show).

rpcNotification.title: Rpc Notification
rpcNotification.description: The server's push of one event. The event is an object here because one schema never references another; rpc_notification_from_value reads it with event_from_value.

commandReply.title: Command Reply
commandReply.description: What the daemon's POST /command answers once the token passes (docs/SPEC.md section 8.2): what the command did, as one sentence and the sequence numbers of the events it appended, or why it did nothing. A reply is what leaves a process, so it has a schema as a command does; catervas_protocol::command::reply_from_value reads it against this definition.

kind.description: invalid: the command cannot be handled as given, a schema refusal among them; refused: it cannot be done to what it names as things stand; not_found: what it names is not there; failed: the store, a file, git, or the orchestrator failed.

design_plan.description: The task's latest UI/UX Designer's plan and the Product Manager's decision on it (ADR 0026), or null when no plan was proposed. reason is the decision's, once there is one.

ui_change.description: Whether the task's change touches the interface (ADR 0026): a Software Developer's task whose contract sets ui_change, or whose branch changes a path the team's ui_paths match.

design_review.description: The UI/UX Designer's design review of the change (step 12), or null when it is not a UI change. state says where it stands; reasons and checks are the latest design_review.recorded since the task last entered verifying, when there is one.

design_reviews.description: Every design_review.recorded of the task, oldest first: the Designer that recorded it, whether it passed, its reasons, and when (step 12). The gate reads the earlier ones as the Designer's send-backs, and the latest as who signed the letter.

team.description: The team file as team.schema.json shapes it.

max_agents.description: The most agents a team may have that are not retired (spec 4.1).

sandboxed.description: Whether sessions run in Docker's sandbox. False in no-sandbox mode, where a command an agent runs can reach a connector's keys (spec 8.6), so no page promises that the agent never sees them.

connectors.description: Each agent's custom MCP servers and whether each runs (ADR 0030): connected when the definition kept on this machine beside its keys is the team file's and every key it names is kept; connect_again when none is kept or the team file changed since, or, for a kit's service, when the kit's tags or fields changed with a release (ADR 0036), so it runs nothing until the user connects it again; sign_in_again when the service ended the agent's sign-in, so it runs nothing until the user signs in again; not_in_kit when a kit's service is no longer in its agent's role's kit, so the page offers Remove alone (ADR 0036); store_unavailable when the keychain or the private file could not be read, the last time Catervas read it, so it is left out of sessions until it can be. The kept definition is read once per connect and disconnect, when a session is set up, and the first time it is asked for.

auth.description: How the server is reached with the user's authority: keys the user gave, or a sign-in to the service (ADR 0033).

revokes.description: For a server signed in to: whether the service has a way to be asked to forget the sign-in when it is removed. Absent for a server with keys.

provider.description: For a server signed in to with one of Catervas's own apps: what the app is called (GitHub), which the page names in place of the server's address (step 03b).

settings_url.description: For the same: the page at the service where the user removes Catervas's app, which Remove's confirmation links to.

stored_in.description: Where the agent's keys for this server are kept, when an entry is: the computer's keychain, or a private file only the user can read. Absent when none is kept or the store could not be read.

source.description: Where the server came from: the user's own, or a service of the agent's role's kit (ADR 0036).

online.description: Whether the project is online: its repository has an origin, and for a project folder every member's repository has one. Finished work then opens a pull request; otherwise it waits on this computer for a merge by hand (spec 5.6, 5.14).

members_present.description: Whether the project folder's repos.yaml lists member repositories (ADR 0057, ADR 0069): each keeps its own integration branch there, so Settings shows no branch field for the team.

preview_env_present.description: Whether the owner's `.catervas/local/preview.env` is there for the preview (ADR 0067). Never its names or values.

hidden_suggestions.description: The kit services the user said Not now to on Today, kept on this computer; Today leaves each pair out of its suggestions.

requested_connections.description: The kit services agents asked the owner to connect with catervas_request_connection (ADR 0063): one entry per agent and server, with the newest reason, ordered by each pair's newest request. Today lists these first.

kits.description: Each role on the team whose kit has a service to connect by name, with the copy the page shows (ADR 0036). A container connector, which Catervas runs itself, is not listed, and nor is a role with no service.

key_page.description: Where the key is made; present when the service takes keys.

labels.description: A tool to what it does in the user's words.

at_launch.description: Present when the service signs in through one of Catervas's own connectors and this build has no app of Catervas's for it: it comes with the web launch (ADR 0044), and the page offers no Connect.

allowances.description: What the kit lets the user pre-approve (ADR 0037): each spending tool with its default calls each period and the plural noun for what a call makes. Present when the kit offers any.

project_root.description: null while the daemon is in setup mode, before a project is chosen.

take_on_error.description: Why taking the chosen project on failed, or null.

setup_pending.description: Whether the project was just set up and waits for the team's setup (the marker .catervas/local/setup-pending).

leaving.description: The root of the project being left while the page chooses another (ADR 0053), or null.

keys_copied.description: Where this project's connector keys were copied from and how many, until the user keeps or changes them; null when none were or after keys_copied.dismiss.

design_review_state.description: tasks.list only, for a task in verifying whose change is to the interface: task.get's design_review.state, so the board need not ask each card (step 12).

taskProjection.description: One row of the board (catervas_store::TaskProjection). Optional fields are absent, not null, when the projection has none.

replace.description: Replace a folder that already has a Catervas team: its .catervas/ is removed and the team of the project being left is carried over (ADR 0053). Without it such a folder is refused as has_team.

projectCreateFolderRequest.title: Project Create Folder Request
projectCreateFolderRequest.description: Makes the project folder parent/name, relative to home, of two to sixteen existing repositories (docs/SPEC.md 4.1; ADR 0057): a local git repository with no remote, holding .catervas/ and docs/catervas/, whose .catervas/repos.yaml lists repos. parent need not exist yet. Every check runs before anything is made, and a refusal is -32005 with a sentence that ends, for a repository, in its path as sent. Answers projectCreateResult. Records team.paused (or, while a project is being left, carries its team) and one repo.added for each repository, and no project.started.

path.description: The repository's top folder, relative to home.

projectLeaveRequest.title: Project Leave Request
projectLeaveRequest.description: Stops the team's driver and lets go of the project, so that the page returns to choosing a project (ADR 0053). Waits, as catervas stop does, for a running session's tick to end. Answers emptyResult.

keysCopiedDismissRequest.title: Keys Copied Dismiss Request
keysCopiedDismissRequest.description: Removes the notice that connector keys were copied from another project (.catervas/local/keys-copied.json) and records no event. Answers emptyResult, also when there is no notice.

connectorSuggestionHideRequest.title: Connector Suggestion Hide Request
connectorSuggestionHideRequest.description: Notes that the user said Not now to suggesting the kit service server to the agent (.catervas/local/connector-suggestions.json), once, and records no event. Answers emptyResult. Refused with REFUSED (suggestion_not_offered) when the agent is not in the team or its role's kit has no such service.

done.description: The build step reached, while preparing and the build has said.

failed.description: Docker's last words, on a missing item whose last build failed.

designer_browser.description: The UI/UX Designer's browser, the Playwright connector's pinned image; present only for a team with a Designer, which setup's suggested team has (step 12).

environment_variable.description: The variable the credential comes from, when it comes from the environment: Catervas cannot remove it, so the page names it rather than offering Disconnect.

key_refused.description: True while the team is paused because the model provider refused the credential (docs/SPEC.md 5.5): the key did not work, and connecting the account again resumes the team. Left out otherwise.

taking_on.description: True when a project that waited on the credential is now being taken on, so the daemon restarts on it.

browserPullRequest.title: Browser Pull Request
browserPullRequest.description: Setup pulls the UI/UX Designer's browser, the Playwright connector's image, by its pinned digest (step 12).

contract.description: A contract as task-contract.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

taskScreenshotQuery.title: Task Screenshot Query
taskScreenshotQuery.description: A screenshot catervas_check_page took of the task's preview (step 12): file is the name one of the task's page.checked events gives, and any other name is not_found.

folderDocProposalsListQuery.title: Folder Doc Proposals List Query
folderDocProposalsListQuery.description: The product plan's changes waiting for the owner (docs/SPEC.md 5.7), as folderDocProposalsListResult shapes them.

folderDocProposalsListResult.description: The changes to the product plan that wait for the owner (docs/SPEC.md 5.7): integration is the team's policy, which says what approving does, and cards has one card for each review and agent, ordered by its first proposal. A card holds sprint_id, agent_id, summary, its proposals' summaries in order joined by one space, and documents, its proposals in order, each with proposal, its number, path, and lines, the changed lines of the document between the integration branch's file and the proposed text (empty when only its twin changes), each with change, same, added or removed, and text. The summary and the lines are the agent's words and untrusted text.

filesSaveRequest.title: Files Save Request
filesSaveRequest.description: The owner's edit of a document of a role's folder (docs/SPEC.md 5.17): base is the blob files.read answered for the document, so that an edit made on a version the team has since changed is refused. The text is committed on a branch of its own as a folder change, which the team's integration policy adds to the project as it does an accepted task's branch. Refused with -32005 and data.errors, each with path (a JSON pointer: /path, /text or /base), message and code, in this order: outside_folders, not_a_document, agent_twin, marketing_plan (/path), too_large (/text, over 262144 bytes), then file_changed (/base: the integration branch has no file there, or its blob is not base), file_busy (/path: the project's checkout has an uncommitted change to it), is_a_link (/path) and change_waiting (/path: an earlier change of the document is not added yet). Saved text the file already holds answers null for both and records nothing.

filesSaveResult.description: The folder change the save made and its branch, both null when the document already said this and nothing was made.

documentAttachRequest.title: Document Attach Request
documentAttachRequest.description: The owner attaches a file (docs/SPEC.md 5.17, ADR 0073): data_base64 (standard base64, at most 10 MiB decoded) is turned into Markdown and committed as the owner's own folder change at docs/catervas/<kind>/attached/<slug>.md, recorded as folder_doc.edited then document.attached, and the integrated change files the task that writes its agent version. Answers the document's path and the change. Refused with -32005 and data.errors, each with path, message and code, in this order: no_folder_owner (/kind: no active agent of the kind's role), unreadable (/data_base64: not base64), unsupported_type, no_text, unreadable and too_large (/data_base64: the file or its text), then file_busy, is_a_link and change_waiting (/name).

documentAttachResult.description: The attached document's path and the folder change that holds it.

filesAskChangeRequest.title: Files Ask Change Request
filesAskChangeRequest.description: The owner asks the role that owns a document to change it (docs/SPEC.md 5.17): files a small, whole task for that role, with no triage or refine session, whose title is Change and the document's name and whose intent quotes words. A change to the spec or the roadmap still waits for the owner's acceptance. words is trimmed. Refused with -32005 and data.errors, each with path, message and code, in this order: not_editable (/path: outside the team's folders, not a document, an agent version or a marketing plan), no_words (/words: blank), no_task_taker (/path: the Scrum Master's folder, whose documents it keeps up to date at its retro), no_owner (/path: no active agent of the folder's role) and not_editable again (/path: a document files.tree does not list).

filesAskChangeResult.description: The task filed for the owner's ask.

filesRewriteRequest.title: Files Rewrite Request
filesRewriteRequest.description: The owner asks the team to rewrite its Markdown documents as HTML (docs/SPEC.md 5.17): files, as the owner's word, one small, whole task for each role other than the Scrum Master whose folder holds a Markdown document (a marketing plan, MP-n, excepted) and that has a reviewer the team can staff, with no triage or refine session, and records document_rewrite.started. Each task rewrites the folder's Markdown documents, and their agent versions, as HTML and removes the Markdown. The Scrum Master's delivery documents are rewritten at its next retro. Refused with -32005 and data.errors, each with an empty path, a message and a code, in this order: not_html (the team writes new documents as Markdown), rewrite_open (a task of the last rewrite is neither accepted nor cancelled) and nothing_to_rewrite (no task can be filed and delivery holds no Markdown document).

filesRewriteResult.description: The tasks filed for the rewrite, in the order the folders are listed; none when only the Scrum Master's documents were Markdown.

filesTreeQuery.title: Files Tree Query
filesTreeQuery.description: The team's folders and their documents, as the integration branch holds them (docs/SPEC.md 5.17), as filesTreeResult shapes them.

filesTreeResult.description: integration is the team's policy, which the page's words follow. folders has one folder for each role that owns one and has an active agent, in the order of the Team rules: folder is its path, name its last segment as words, role the role that owns it, agent_id that role's first active agent, and documents its .md and .html files at any depth, in the order of the known documents and then by path, each with path, name (the Files page's name for it; a plan's carries its title, which is the agent's own words and untrusted text) and twin, the path of its .agent.md or .agent.html twin when it has one that is a file, else null, and task, the accepted task still waiting to merge whose branch alone holds the document, else null; such a document is read from that branch and cannot be edited. A twin of a document that is present is not listed on its own; a link is not listed.

reposListQuery.title: Repos List Query
reposListQuery.description: The member repositories of a project folder (docs/SPEC.md 4.1; ADR 0057), as reposListResult shapes them. A project of one repository has no .catervas/repos.yaml and answers repos null.

reposListResult.description: repos is null for a project of one repository, else the members in the order .catervas/repos.yaml lists them: name, path (canonical, absolute), integration_branch as written or null for the repository's default branch, and missing, true when path is not a directory or git's top folder of it is not path itself (a fact read when asked, with no event).

repoAddRequest.title: Repo Add Request
repoAddRequest.description: Adds a repository to a project folder (docs/SPEC.md 4.1; ADR 0057): path is relative to home. Refused with -32005 and data.errors, each with path (a JSON pointer), message and code: not_a_project_folder (/, no .catervas/repos.yaml), then not_there, outside_home, home_itself, not_a_repository, not_the_top, has_team (/path), repo_name, name_taken (/name), path_taken, nested, inside_project_folder, holds_project_folder (/path), too_many_repos (/name) and no_such_branch (/integration_branch). Writes .catervas/repos.yaml, then records repo.added. Answers emptyResult.

repoRemoveRequest.title: Repo Remove Request
repoRemoveRequest.description: Removes a repository from a project folder, touching no file of the repository (docs/SPEC.md 4.1; ADR 0057). -32002 when no member has the name; refused with -32005 and data.errors last_repo (/name) when it is the only member. Writes .catervas/repos.yaml, then records repo.removed. Answers emptyResult.

repoLocateRequest.title: Repo Locate Request
repoLocateRequest.description: Records where a member repository is now (docs/SPEC.md 4.1; ADR 0057): path is relative to home, and is held to the checks repo.add holds a path to, the member itself left out of the others. It works whether or not the member is missing. -32002 when no member has the name. Writes .catervas/repos.yaml, then records repo.moved. Answers emptyResult.

filesReadQuery.title: Files Read Query
filesReadQuery.description: One document of the tree with its twin, as the integration branch holds them, as filesReadResult shapes it. A path files.tree would not list (a twin that has its document, a link, a file that is not there, a path outside the folders) is -32002.

fileVersion.description: One file as a branch holds it: its text (the agents' or the owner's own words, untrusted), blob (its object hash, which files.save takes as base) and last_change, the last commit along the integration branch's first parents that changed it, null when none did: at, when; task_id and agent_id, the task and its assignee when the commit's subject names a task on the board, or the agent that wrote or proposed it when it names a folder change; author, the commit's author name; by_you, whether the owner made it.

filesReadResult.description: document and its twin (null when it has none that is a file) as the integration branch holds them, except that while the owner's own saved change to the document waits to be added (waiting: its folder change and branch) they are read from that branch, with by_you true. stale: the twin is behind the document (read from git; an owner's change not yet added makes nothing stale). rederiving: a task that brings the twin up to date is neither accepted nor cancelled. editable: false for a marketing plan, which changes through a new version on its page. askable: false for a document under docs/catervas/delivery/, which the Scrum Master alone writes, otherwise equal to editable.

attached.description: For a document the owner attached (ADR 0073), the name of the file it came from; null for any other.

requestFileRequest.title: Request File Request
requestFileRequest.description: Files the person's words as a draft request. Answers requestFileResult; a refusal of words under 20 characters carries data with errors, each a path, a message and a code, the code too_short, as team.validate answers them.

text.description: The request in the person's words: its first line is the title, and the whole is the intent. The daemon refuses a text under 20 characters.

from_chat_message.description: The seq of the agent's chat reply whose proposed request this is: the reply must carry a request not already sent, or the daemon refuses with a sentence. task.created records it.

attachments.description: The documents the owner attached (docs/SPEC.md 5.17, ADR 0073): up to five attached documents a document.attached recorded, which task.created records. Refused with -32005 and data.errors: too_many_attachments (/attachments: more than five) and not_attached (/attachments/<i>: a path no document.attached recorded).

contract.description: A contract as task-contract.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

waitingListResult.description: What waits on the human: first the marketing plans whose ads Catervas could not keep within their budget or keep paused, one row each, by precedence (marketing_budget: the active plan whose ads reached a budget, titled "Ads budget reached: <plan>", with plan, plan_title, ends_on, currency, google_ads, the plan's Google Ads budget, spent, what Google Ads reported spent, read_at, when it was read, reason, Google's or Catervas's words when Catervas could not pause the ads, cap, the budget the row's words are about (a pause Google refused can keep it from being the newest), caps, each budget reached, campaigns, each campaign of the plan with its budget and spend, and raising, the task of a request to raise the budget that is open; marketing_ads_running: a plan whose ads Catervas could not pause, with reason, titled "Ads still running: <plan>"; marketing_spend_unread: the active plan whose spend Catervas cannot read, with reason and the last spend and its time, titled "Can't read the ad spend: <plan>"; task_id is the task of the plan's proposal and agent_id the agent that proposed it; amounts are decimal strings), then questions first, then connector calls waiting to be allowed (tool_approval, each with approval, the seq of its tool_approval.requested, its server, its bare tool name, and its whole input as compact JSON, which only that kind carries), then marketing plans waiting for the owner (marketing_plan, whose title is the plan's and whose line is "<agent name> proposes a marketing plan: <title>", each with plan, its id, its summary, its total budget as a decimal string, its currency, and its first and last day, which only that kind carries), then posts outside the plan waiting for the owner (social_post, whose title is its task's and whose line is "<agent name> wants to post on <Network>", each with post, its number, channel, text, media, the pictures and clips as their addresses with kind image or video, and at, when it would go out in the offset it was written in, which only that kind carries; a post that was decided or whose time came is no longer listed), then purchase orders the Procurement Specialist suggested, waiting for the owner (purchase_order, whose title is its task's and whose line is "<agent name> set up an order from <seller>: <total> <currency>", each with order, its number, seller, seller_contact, lines (each with item, quantity, unit, unit_price and line_total), currency, period, total, delivery, terms, url, the seller's page exactly as the agent wrote it or empty, host, the site that address names in its ASCII form, absent when url is empty, evaluation, why, at, when it was drafted, and expires_at, when Catervas closes it by itself, which only that kind carries and of which every text is the agent's own and untrusted; an order that was decided or expired is no longer listed and an order holds no task), then data pipeline requests the Product Manager passed to the owner or did not decide, waiting for the owner (data_pipeline, whose title is its task's and whose line is "<agent name> asks for a data source: <name>", each with pipeline, its number, name, what, the source would give, url, the source's own page exactly as the agent wrote it, host, the site that address names in its ASCII form, why, cost, one of free, paid and unknown, needs_account, sends_project_data, reason, the Product Manager's reason, absent when Catervas passed the request on after the Product Manager's three tries, at, when the agent asked, and request_text, the text of the request an approval files, which only that kind carries and of which every text but host and the labels is the agent's own and untrusted; a request that was decided is no longer listed, an open one waits on the Product Manager, and a request holds no task), approvals, other escalations, acceptances, and integrations (under manual, a folder change that waits for the owner to add it is one too, with folder_change, its number, and no task_id); then the UI changes whose design review waits for the team's preview (preview_missing), for Docker's sandbox (designer_needs_sandbox), or for Playwright to be turned on for the Designer (designer_needs_browser).

contract.description: A contract as task-contract.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

contractCheckResult.description: The rules an unsaved plan fails: schema errors first, as rule schema, then the Definition of Ready's; total is the number of checks run, the schema counting as one.

taskDiffResult.description: A task's diff against the integration branch, or an epic's tasks' integrated diffs joined in id order, each under a # CTV-n line.

branch.description: The task's branch, as Catervas recorded it at the task's start (ADR 0066); absent for an epic and a task in a private folder.

private_folder.description: True for a task that works in its role's private folder, which has no diff to show: diff is then empty, and files names what changed in the folder since the copy taken when the task was assigned.

taskChecksResult.description: Each criterion's latest result since the task last entered verifying; for a plan awaiting approval, the Definition of Ready's failures, each named by its rule.

taskTriesResult.description: The try in progress, iteration + 1, of max_iterations + 1 plus the extra tries granted: the limit bounds returns, and the pass after the last return is a try too.

escalationChoicesResult.description: What the human may do about an escalation (ADR 0062): each choice's label, what happens next in plain words, whether the team suggests it, and either the command the page sends (kind command; body, to which the page adds the message of a resolve) or the page it opens (kind open; path). The first is the suggested one.

contractSaveResult.description: The human's edit is saved; back_to_refining says a frozen plan went back to refining, to be checked and approved again.

taskCostsResult.description: What a task has spent, by the purposes' plain words (Planning: triage, refine, plan; Building: implement; Checking: verify; Meetings and talk: ceremony, conversation; Conversations: chat), each word that has spent anything, and its contract's limit.

catervaficationGetResult.description: Whether the team offers to document an existing repository now, and with which roles (docs/SPEC.md 4.1, 5.16, ADR 0051). offered is true while the log holds neither catervafication.started nor project.started and a Start would not be refused for want of a Product Manager and someone to check its notes. roles are the roles that would get a task, in the order they are filed.

productPlanStateResult.description: Where a new project's product plan stands (docs/SPEC.md 4.3). new_project is the project's name when it was started from a paragraph, null for any other. approved is true when both documents are on the integration branch, and false with no new project. task is the newest task that drafts the plan and is still open (not cancelled, and not accepted with its integration done), null when there is none. documents holds spec.md then roadmap.md as the task's branch has them, each left out when git has none there, while the task is verifying, and is empty otherwise.

marketingPlanListResult.description: Every marketing plan, newest first (docs/SPEC.md 6.5; ADR 0042): its id, title, state, dates, currency and total budget as a decimal string with two decimals, the agent that proposed it and the task it waited on the owner for, and when it was proposed. state is proposed (waiting for the owner), returned (sent back), approved (approved, and not the plan in force: not started, or another is active), active (approved, and the plan in force today) or ended.

marketingPlanGetResult.description: One marketing plan whole (docs/SPEC.md 6.5; ADR 0042): what was proposed, its state as in marketing_plan.list, the owner's decision with their words (note for an approval, empty when they added nothing; reason for a plan sent back) and when, or null while it waits, and its end with why and when, the owner's note when they ended it with one and the plan that replaced it when a newer plan did, or null. text is the plan's text, to be shown as text and never rendered as markup. Refused not_found for a plan nobody proposed. Beside them, what Catervas's watch last read of the plan's Google Ads spend (spend, when it has tried), the budgets its ads reached (reached) and the campaigns Catervas paused on its own (paused), step 08g.

format.description: The format the plan's text was written in: html when it is a page, else markdown.

advertises.description: What the campaign advertises; empty for a plan proposed before the field existed.

price.description: fixed when Google keeps a total budget for the campaign, which it never bills past (3 to 90 days), else not_fixed: a daily budget, which may run over by about an hour's spend. As of today while the plan waits, and as of the day the owner approved it once it is approved.

written_posts.description: The posts the Marketing Specialist wrote for this plan's slots, oldest first, each with where it stands: a slot may have several, an earlier one failed, missed or stopped and a newer one written for it. at is when it goes out, in the offset it was written in; state_at is when it reached that state. stopped_by (owner, declined or plan_ended) is there for a stopped post, and missed_why for a missed one. text is shown as text and never rendered as markup.

note.description: What the owner said when they ended the plan, as they wrote it; left out when they said nothing.

replaced_by.description: The plan that took its place, when why is replaced.

spend.description: What Catervas's watch last read of the plan's Google Ads spend, kept in memory while the process runs (step 08g); left out until the watch has tried. read_at, total and by_key are the last read that worked (decimal strings, by plan campaign key); failed is why the last try did not, with failed_at, when.

reached.description: The budgets of the plan its ads reached, oldest first: a campaign's own or the plan's Google Ads budget, with what was spent and the budget, and failed, the first refusal's words when Google would not take a pause.

paused.description: The campaigns Catervas paused on its own, oldest first, each with its plan campaign's key and name and why: its budget was reached, the plan ended, or Google Ads was removed.

purchaseOrdersListResult.description: Every purchase order the Procurement Specialist suggested, oldest first (docs/SPEC.md 6.10; ADR 0039): order, its number, the n of PO-n; state, one of drafted, approved, rejected, placed, received, closed and expired; seller, total, currency and period (the agent's words, untrusted); task_id and agent_id; drafted_at; decided_at and note, when the owner approved or rejected it and what they said; close_note, what they said closing a placed order; placed_on, the day the owner placed it, with paid, what they paid, and paid_currency; received_on and renews_on; ended_at, when it was rejected, received, closed or expired; status, the latest follow-up status of a placed order, with its note (the agent's words when by is agent, the owner's own when by is owner), expected_on, by, and at; expires_at, when Catervas closes a drafted or an approved order by itself; and overdue, whether a placed order's expected day has passed.

renewalsListResult.description: The renewals coming up (docs/SPEC.md 6.10; ADR 0039): open is every renewal Catervas flagged that the owner has not dismissed, oldest first, each with renewal, its number, vendor (the register's own text, untrusted), renews_on, decide_by, the last day to change or cancel it, and flagged_at; unreadable is how many rows of the register the last daily check could not read, 0 before any check.

procurementMailboxGetResult.description: The procurement mailbox (docs/SPEC.md 6.10; ADR 0039): connected; when it is, address, name (as sellers see it), provider (gmail, icloud, fastmail or other), folder, signature and disclose_ai (what Catervas adds under each message), checked_at (when Catervas last read the mailbox), error (Catervas's own sentence about the last check that failed) and restarted_at (when the provider renumbered the folder); and always sent_today, the messages sent on the UTC day, and cap, the most Catervas sends in one. The password is never in it.

sellerMessagesListResult.description: Every message the Procurement Specialist drafted to a seller, oldest first (docs/SPEC.md 6.10; ADR 0039): message, its number; state, waiting, sent, discarded or closed (an order's message whose order was decided without it); seller, to, subject and body (the agent's words, untrusted; for a sent message the subject and the text the owner sent, with what Catervas added); domain, the address's domain in its ASCII form; new_domain, whether no message sent before went to that domain; purpose; purchase_order, the order an order's message or a follow-up is about; task_id and agent_id; drafted_at; sent_at and edited, once sent; why, Catervas's sentence about the last try that failed while the message waits, and failed_at, when that try failed. sent_today counts the messages sent on the UTC day, orders' included, and cap is the most Catervas sends in one.

procurementMailboxCheckResult.description: How many replies the check recorded.

sellerReplyAttachmentResult.description: An attachment of a seller's reply: media_type (application/pdf, image/png or image/jpeg), its bytes as base64, and a name made from the reply and the index with the extension its bytes call for, never the seller's own file name.

sellerRepliesListResult.description: Every reply Catervas read in the procurement mailbox, oldest first (docs/SPEC.md 6.10, 8.6): reply, its number; message, the message of Catervas's it answers, with task_id, the message's task, and seller and sent_subject, what Catervas sent (the subject shown is never the reply's own); from, subject, text, date and attachments, what the seller wrote (untrusted; text is at most 64 KiB, and each attachment has its index counted from 1, the name the seller gave it as text, kept, media_type and bytes when kept); received_at; order, set for a reply to an order's message or a follow-up; and dismissed, whether the owner dismissed it.

purchaseOrderEvaluationResult.description: The comparison an order rests on, evaluations/<name>.md in the agent's private folder, as text: the agent's own words, untrusted, shown as text and never as a page.

socialPostsListResult.description: The posts Today shows (docs/SPEC.md 6.5; ADR 0042): every post scheduled or sent whose time is still ahead, soonest first, then every post missed or failed in the last 24 hours, the latest first. A post stopped, one still waiting for the owner (waiting.list has it), and one whose time passed unsent are not here. at is when it goes out, in the offset it was written in; hands_over_at is when Catervas hands it to Buffer, in UTC: an hour before at, or later for a post the owner allowed later than that. approved_by is plan, owner or catervas (a post outside the plan, which costs nothing: ADR 0061); plan and slot are there for a plan's post. missed_why is there for a missed post and reason, Catervas's sentence then Buffer's words, for a failed one: both are shown as text, never as markup.

socialPostMediaRequest.title: Social Post Media Request
socialPostMediaRequest.description: One picture of a post, fetched by the daemon, since the browser may not load pictures from other sites. Answers socialPostMediaResult; refused not_found for an unknown post or picture, for a clip (the page opens its address in a new tab), and for an address that is not public, is gone, is not a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP picture (never an SVG), or is over 20 MiB.

procurementMailboxGetQuery.title: Procurement Mailbox Get Query
procurementMailboxGetQuery.description: The procurement mailbox (docs/SPEC.md 6.10; ADR 0039): { connected, address?, name?, provider?, folder?, checked_at?, error?, restarted_at?, sent_today, cap }. The password is never in it. checked_at is when Catervas last read the mailbox; error is Catervas's own sentence about the last check that failed; restarted_at is when the provider renumbered the folder; sent_today counts the messages sent to sellers on the UTC day, of the cap.

procurementMailboxConnectRequest.title: Procurement Mailbox Connect Request
procurementMailboxConnectRequest.description: Connects the procurement mailbox (docs/SPEC.md 6.6, 6.10; ADR 0039): Catervas logs in to both servers over TLS with the certificate checked, sending nothing, then keeps the password in the OS keychain (or, without one, a private file) and records mailbox.connected. provider is gmail, icloud, fastmail (whose servers Catervas knows and uses in place of imap and smtp), other (the servers given) or microsoft, which is refused mailbox_provider_unsupported before any connection, as is an address at outlook.com, hotmail.com, live.com or msn.com. folder defaults to INBOX, signature to none and disclose_ai to true. A refusal of these params carries no data, as account.connect's does; a refusal of the mailbox is mailbox_login_failed, mailbox_needs_tls, mailbox_certificate, mailbox_unreachable, mailbox_server or mailbox_settings_invalid, each in Catervas's words, never quoting the password. Connecting again replaces all of it. Answers emptyResult.

procurementMailboxDisconnectRequest.title: Procurement Mailbox Disconnect Request
procurementMailboxDisconnectRequest.description: Disconnects the procurement mailbox: Catervas forgets its password and deletes mail/mailbox.json, keeps mail/out/ and mail/in/, and records mailbox.disconnected. Answers emptyResult.

procurementMailboxCheckRequest.title: Procurement Mailbox Check Request
procurementMailboxCheckRequest.description: Reads the procurement mailbox now, as Catervas does by itself every 15 minutes with no model (docs/SPEC.md 6.10): only messages addressed to the procurement address that answer a message Catervas sent, or come from an address it wrote to, are opened. Answers procurementMailboxCheckResult; refused mailbox_not_connected, or with the reason a login or a server gave, in Catervas's words (mailbox_login_failed, mailbox_needs_tls, mailbox_certificate, mailbox_unreachable, mailbox_server). A check already running answers replies 0.

sellerReplyAttachmentRequest.title: Seller Reply Attachment Request
sellerReplyAttachmentRequest.description: A file a seller attached to a reply, for the owner to download: answers sellerReplyAttachmentResult; refused not_found for a reply nobody received, an index it has not (counted from 1) and a file that was not kept (Catervas keeps only PDFs and pictures of 10 MB or less, as their bytes say).

purchaseOrderFileRequest.title: Purchase Order File Request
purchaseOrderFileRequest.description: An order's workbook, orders/PO-<n>.xlsx, for the owner to download: answers purchaseOrderFileResult; refused not_found for an order nobody drafted, for a workbook that is gone, and for one that is, or lies behind, a link.

marketingBudgetRaiseRequest.title: Marketing Budget Raise Request
marketingBudgetRaiseRequest.description: The owner raises the budget of the active marketing plan whose ads reached it (docs/SPEC.md 6.7; ADR 0042, step 08g): google_ads is the plan's new Google Ads budget, in the plan's currency, and campaigns the new budget of each campaign that reached its own, each more than what was spent. The plan's total rises by the same amount as google_ads. Catervas files a request for a new version of the plan, triaged small at once and never held, and answers marketingBudgetRaiseResult. Refused with errors, each a path, a message and a code: raise_refused (the plan is not the active one, has reached no budget, or an amount is not enough or does not fit) or raise_open (a raise of the plan is open already).

allowancesListResult.description: What each connected kit connector of an active agent lets it make without asking, and how many it has made this period (docs/SPEC.md 6.7, ADR 0037): the period, the UTC day (ADR 0062), and one row per allowance. used counts every call of the tool in the period, those a grant allowed among them, so it may exceed of. what is the kit's plural noun for what a call makes.

costsSummaryResult.description: Today's spending (UTC) and the team's daily limit, today's one-to-one chats (purpose chat), and each agent's that is not retired, in the team's order.

metricsResult.description: The harness metrics of F17, over the project; a rate is null while no task is accepted.

teamProposeQuery.title: Team Propose Query
teamProposeQuery.description: The team setup suggests: the team as it is with the five suggested agents in place of its own, and the criterion library as it is, which the setup form edits beside it.

teamValidateQuery.title: Team Validate Query

team.description: A team as team.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

teamValidateQuery.description: A changed team checked and described before it is saved (docs/SPEC.md section 10). Nothing is written.

modelsListQuery.title: Models List Query
modelsListQuery.description: The newest model of each family the price table prices, with the words a person reads for it.

teamSaveRequest.title: Team Save Request
teamSaveRequest.description: Writes the team when it has no errors and appends team.updated. It refuses a status change (an agent is paused, retired or resumed from its card) and removing an agent the log has seen work from. Answers emptyResult; a refusal's data holds errors, each a path, a message and a code, as team.validate answers them.

team.description: A team as team.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

teamStartRequest.title: Team Start Request
teamStartRequest.description: The setup form's Start the team: writes the team and the criteria, removes the setup marker, and appends team.updated, criteria.updated and, when the marker was there and the team is paused, team.resumed: without the marker a paused team stays paused. While the marker is there it may replace the starter team's agents. Answers emptyResult.

team.description: A team as team.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

criteria.description: A criterion library as criteria.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

criteriaSaveRequest.title: Criteria Save Request
criteriaSaveRequest.description: Writes the criterion library when it is one and appends criteria.updated. Answers emptyResult.

criteria.description: A criterion library as criteria.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

accountDisconnectRequest.title: Account Disconnect Request
accountDisconnectRequest.description: Deletes the AI account's credential from every store that holds it and, when one did, pauses the team. A credential from the environment cannot be removed: nothing is deleted, and the answer names its variable.

team.description: A team as team.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

criteria.description: A criterion library as criteria.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

unavailable.description: The proposed agents this computer cannot run, which setup shows unticked: the UI/UX Designer, with designer_needs_sandbox, where Catervas runs without Docker's sandbox (step 12, D3).

suggested_teams.description: Every ready-made team once, the one that fits the folder best first (design/team-picker.md section 5).

role_defaults.description: Each role's shipped model, effort and persona, keyed by the role's wire name.

effects.description: Each effect of the change in plain words; empty when there are errors.

agents.description: The team as it would be, as team.get answers it; left out when there are errors.

paused.description: Whether this call paused the team: true only when a credential was removed and the team was running. A team already paused stays paused and answers false.

environment_variable.description: The variable the credential comes from, when it comes from the environment and so could not be removed.

projectScanQuery.title: Project Scan Query
projectScanQuery.description: The project scanned again, as the setup screen "What we found" reads it back in rows. Nothing is written.

projectNoteRequest.title: Project Note Request
projectNoteRequest.description: Something is wrong: the user's words kept in .catervas/project.md under "The user says", which every rescan carries across. Answers emptyResult.

text.description: What the user says about the project, in their own words.

language.description: The language with the most tracked files.

workspace.description: Whether the project is a workspace.

packages.description: How many packages the workspace has.

tests_in.description: Where the tests are, as a location.

last_commit.description: How long ago the last commit was, in words; null before the first commit.

checks.description: The text of each check the scan found in the project's own commands.

prepare.description: Installs what the project needs, for the preview.

start.description: Starts the app: one of the project's own dev, start or preview scripts. Null when the project has none or is not run through a package manager (ADR 0054).

app_start.description: How the app is likely started, from the project's package.json scripts; null when it cannot be told.

kept_private.description: The protected-path globs that match something on disk, walked four folders deep without .git and node_modules, over at most 2000 entries.

facts.description: What the scan found in the member, shaped as the project's own facts; null when the member is not there or its scan failed.

checks.description: The text of each check the member's scan found; empty when it was not read.

error.description: Why the member was not read: not found, or the scan's own sentence; null when it was read.

repos.description: One row per member repository in repos.yaml order, each from a scan of that member alone; null for a project of one repository. The facts, checks and app_start above stay the project folder's own.

connectorServer.description: A service as the user connects it, before its tools are labelled: either a custom MCP server, an mcp_servers entry of team.schema.json without tools (name, transport, and command and args, or url and headers, credential_keys, and oauth for a web address the user signs in to, or for Catervas's own connector, the stdio entry `catervas connector <name>`, which Catervas signs in with its own app (ADR 0033's amendment of 2026-10-06); source, when given, is custom), held to validate_team as the agent's entry; or a service of the agent's role's kit, { name, source: kit }, a form of its own that carries nothing else, so a browser cannot send fields the kit decides (ADR 0036).

kitServer.description: A service of the agent's role's kit, by name: the daemon builds its entry from the kit (kit_entry), its tags included. connector.connect with it takes tags {} (kit_names_these otherwise); a name the agent's role's kit does not have is connector_not_in_kit.

connectorKeys.description: Each of the server's keys by name, with its value. Never echoed: a refusal of these params carries no data.

connectorToolsRequest.title: Connector Tools Request
connectorToolsRequest.description: Lists a custom MCP server's tools, started or reached with the agent's keys, or with the sign-in an attempt made when the server has oauth, as ConnectorAdd's second step shows them (docs/SPEC.md 5.6; ADRs 0030 and 0033). Nothing is kept, and the attempt is not used up. A server with oauth and no attempt is refused sign_in_needed; an attempt that is unknown, used, expired, unfinished, or another server's is refused sign_in_unknown. A refusal of these params carries no data, as account.connect's does.

usable.description: False for a name Claude Code would rewrite (outside ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$): Catervas can't use this tool, and it is never written to the team file.

connectorConnectRequest.title: Connector Connect Request
connectorConnectRequest.description: Gives the agent a custom MCP server (docs/SPEC.md 5.6, 6.7; ADR 0030): its tools listed with the keys, each usable one labelled by tags or else paid, the keys kept in the keychain or a private file beside the definition's spec_sha256, then connector_connect handled, which writes the team file and appends connector.connected. A server with oauth takes attempt, a finished sign-in, in place of keys, and uses it up; its grant is kept where keys are, and a grant it replaces is asked to be forgotten. A refusal of these params carries no data, as account.connect's does; a refusal of the entry carries the team's errors, each at its field.

tags.description: The user's label for each tool by name; a listed tool not named here is paid.

connectorAllowances.description: How many calls each period the agent makes of each spending tool without asking (ADR 0037), 0 to 1000; the daemon refuses one outside it allowance_out_of_range, and one for a tool the kit gives none allowance_not_offered. A kit service only; left out at a connect, each tool starts at the kit's default.

connectorAllowancesRequest.title: Connector Allowances Request
connectorAllowancesRequest.description: Changes a kit connector's allowances without its key typed again (docs/SPEC.md 6.7; ADR 0037): the kept entry must be the team file's (connector_not_confirmed), the numbers are checked as connect checks them over the ones the entry holds, the same keys or sign-in are kept beside the new entry's hash, then connector_connect is handled, which writes the team file and appends connector.connected. A kit that has changed the service is connector_not_in_kit: connect it again. A tool left out keeps its number. Answers emptyResult.

stored_in.description: Where the keys were kept: the computer's keychain, or a private file only the user can read.

tools.description: Each tool as it was written to the team file, with its label.

signInAttempt.description: A sign-in under way, held in the daemon's memory for ten minutes, bound to the agent and the server (name, url and oauth) it was made for, and used up by connector.connect.

connectorSignInRequest.title: Connector Sign In Request
connectorSignInRequest.description: Starts signing the agent in to the service of a web-address server (docs/SPEC.md 6.7; ADR 0033): finds how the server offers it, registers Catervas as a client or uses the one the server names, opens a listener for the way back on this computer's loopback, and answers the address the user opens in the browser. A new attempt for the same agent and server ends the old one. Refused sign_in_not_offered (the server does not say it can be signed in to), sign_in_not_supported (it does, and Catervas has no way to register), pkce_not_supported, or sign_in_failed, each as the message's first word and a colon. server is the object connector.tools takes, and holds oauth.

authorize_url.description: The service's page, which the browser opens. No token is in it.

issuer.description: Who signs the user in, as the service says. Its host is what the page names; it can differ from the server's, as Stripe's sign-in is at access.stripe.com.

provider.description: What Catervas's own app for the service is called (GitHub), when one signs the user in: the page names it in place of the issuer's host (step 03b).

user_code.description: The short code the user types on authorize_url, for an app that signs in with a code (the device flow). The code Catervas polls with is never sent.

install_url.description: Where the user installs Catervas's own app on what the agent is to read, when it must be (a private repository on GitHub).

connectorSignInStatusRequest.title: Connector Sign In Status Request
connectorSignInStatusRequest.description: How an attempt is going. Refused sign_in_unknown for one that is not known, was used up, ended, or expired. Never answers a token.

connectorSignInCancelRequest.title: Connector Sign In Cancel Request
connectorSignInCancelRequest.description: Ends an attempt because the person pressed Cancel (docs/SPEC.md 6.7): its polling or its listener stops, and whatever the service says afterwards, or said already, is dropped, so a sign-in approved after Cancel is never kept. Answers emptyResult, also for an attempt that is already gone or was used up, since there is nothing left to end.

message.description: Catervas's words for the step that failed and, where there was one, the HTTP status. It quotes nothing the service sent.

connectorTag.description: A connector tool's label (docs/SPEC.md 5.6): network, only reads; external_effect, changes something outside the sandbox and runs without asking; paid, costs money and asks (ADR 0061); denied, never offered.

connectorDisconnectRequest.title: Connector Disconnect Request
connectorDisconnectRequest.description: Takes a custom MCP server away from the agent: connector_disconnect handled, which removes its team file entry and appends connector.disconnected, then its keys deleted from wherever they are kept; another agent's are never touched. Answers emptyResult.

agentReplaceRequest.title: Agent Replace Request
agentReplaceRequest.description: Replace: the agent retired and a newcomer added, in one validated change to the team file, so that a team is never left without the role the agent held. Appends agent.updated, then team.updated. Answers emptyResult; a refusal's data holds errors, each a path, a message and a code, as team.validate answers them, as team.save's does.

newcomer.description: The agent that joins, as team.schema.json shapes an agent; the daemon validates the team it makes.

effectiveAgent.title: Effective Agent
effectiveAgent.description: An agent as its sessions run: its model and effort (its own, or else its role's), the model's words, the tiers it holds, and base_tiers, those its role and the team's permission answers give it before its own grants and revokes.

label.description: The family's words, with (older) when a newer one of the family is priced; the id when no family names it.

settingsDefaultsQuery.title: Settings Defaults Query
settingsDefaultsQuery.description: What putting a setting back puts back (spec 10): catervas_core::team::defaults(), the same values catervas init writes.

budgets.description: The team's budgets as team.schema.json shapes them, with no daily limit.

policy.description: The starter policy, with the plan check and the permission answers written out.

rules.description: The rules the team adds to Catervas's; none by default.

ui_paths.description: The UI paths every team starts with (spec 5.12): a Software Developer's change that touches one is design-reviewed.

channelMessagesQuery.title: Channel Messages Query
channelMessagesQuery.description: The team channel's newest page of messages before before_seq, or the newest of all without it (spec 5.9).

chatsListQuery.title: Chats List Query
chatsListQuery.description: The chat list (spec 4.3, 5.9): Team's newest line, then each agent's one-to-one chat.

chatLine.title: Chat Line
chatLine.description: A chat's or the channel's newest message.

chatsListResult.description: team_last is the channel's newest message.posted that is not Catervas's system line; chats holds every agent of the team in the team's order, retired ones too with retired true, each with its chat's newest chat_message.posted.

chatMessagesQuery.title: Chat Messages Query
chatMessagesQuery.description: One agent's one-to-one chat, its newest page of messages before before_seq, or the newest of all without it (spec 4.3).

chatMessagesResult.description: One page of the agent's chat_message.posted, oldest first within the page: seq and at from the envelope, and the body's author, text (line breaks kept), in_reply_to, request and heard (what the Product Manager heard in a new project's interview: customers, problem, must, not_now, works_when), null when it has none; sent_as is the request the user sent a reply's proposal as (request.file's from_chat_message), null when not sent. waiting says why the user's newest message has no answer yet, null when the agent answered or nobody wrote; when several reasons apply the first wins: retired, key_refused (the team is paused because the provider refused the key), day_spent (the team's daily budget; the message is kept), asleep with until, answering (a session answers or is about to), no_answer (a session ended without a reply: the user asks again). No event is written for a chat that did not run (ADR 0026).

attachments.description: The documents the owner attached to the message, each with the file's name from its document.attached; the key is absent when there are none.

channelMessagesResult.description: One page of message.posted, oldest first within the page: seq and at from the envelope, task_id the task the message is about, and the body's fields, thread and in_reply_to null when it has none.

attachments.description: The documents the owner attached to the message, each with the file's name from its document.attached; the key is absent when there are none.

teamError.title: Team Error
teamError.description: One reason a team is refused: where, the daemon's sentence for a log, and the code the page words it by.

code.description: The refusal as the page words it for a person; the message is for a log, and invalid is any refusal with no words of its own.

templatesListQuery.title: Templates List Query
templatesListQuery.description: The ready-made teams, the saved teams on this computer, each whole, and the files in the templates folder that are not one. Without a state folder it answers the ready-made teams alone, with folder null. template.save, template.rename and template.delete, and template.preview and template.apply of a saved team, are refused with -32005 and the code no_state_folder at / when Catervas has no state folder; this list and a ready-made team's preview and apply are not. A saved file under a ready-made team's slug is listed as unreadable, and saving or renaming to a ready-made team's name is refused with template_builtin at /name.

skillsListQuery.title: Skills List Query
skillsListQuery.description: The skills one agent has (docs/SPEC.md 6.7; ADR 0034): its role's, the team's and its own, each with how it stands for that agent. An agent the team does not have is -32002.

skillGetQuery.title: Skill Get Query
skillGetQuery.description: Every file of the team's or one agent's skill name, as its folder holds them now, for the person to read (docs/SPEC.md 6.7; ADR 0034). A folder that is not there is -32002; one the checks refuse, a file that is not UTF-8 text among them (skill_file_not_text), is refused with -32005 and a message starting with the refusal's skill_* code, and no files. An agent level names its agent, a team level names none and a role level names its role; any other is refused with -32005. A role level answers the SKILL.md Catervas ships for that role, with no hash.

role.description: A role level's role id, such as software_developer.

description.description: When the skill applies, as its SKILL.md says; empty when that cannot be read.

state.description: in_use: it loads in the agent's sessions (a role's, unless replaced). replaced: another level's skill of the same name stands in its place. review: its folder, its pin and this computer's confirmation do not agree, or a check refuses it; it waits for the person to read and confirm it. missing: pinned, and its folder is not there.

bytes.description: The folder's total size; 0 when missing; a role's, its SKILL.md's.

skillsListResult.description: skills.list's answer: the agent's skills, role rows first, then the team's, then its own, each in the order its list holds. Role rows are read-only.

skillGetResult.description: skill.get's answer: files maps each path to its text as the folder holds it, sha256 is skill_sha256 of the folder (the hash skill_confirm is given; a role level answers none, since a shipped skill is trusted and pinned in the binary), and ignored_fields names the frontmatter keys other than name and description, which Catervas drops from a session's copy.

templatePreviewQuery.title: Template Preview Query

slug.description: The saved team's file name without .yaml, as templates.list answers it.

templatePreviewQuery.description: What using a saved team would make of this project's team: who stays, joins, is retired or removed, the effects in words, and the errors that would refuse it. Nothing is written. A slug with no file is -32002; a file that is not a template is refused with template_unreadable at /slug.

templateSaveRequest.title: Template Save Request
templateSaveRequest.description: Saves this project's team as a template under name, in the state folder, and records no event. A name whose slug another template holds is refused with template_exists at /name unless replace is true; a name with no letter or digit, with template_name at /name. Answers templateSlugResult.

name.description: The saved team's name, as the person typed it; the daemon trims it. The name of a ready-made team is refused with -32005 and template_builtin at /name, whatever replace says.

replace.description: Write over the template that holds the name's slug.

templateApplyRequest.title: Template Apply Request
templateApplyRequest.description: Uses a saved team on this project: worked out again from the team as it is now, so a preview gone stale applies nothing wrong, then the team written once, each retirement's effects (agent.updated, and each in_progress task it held blocked), and team.updated with the template's name. Answers templateAppliedResult, its errors empty; a result the team's rules refuse is refused with -32005, writing nothing, and data.errors as template.preview answers them; so is a template whose file changed since its preview, with template_changed at /digest.

slug.description: The saved team's file name without .yaml, as templates.list answers it.

digest.description: The digest template.preview answered with what it showed. A template file whose bytes differ since then (saved again, or edited by hand) is refused with template_changed at /digest, writing nothing, so its answers are applied only as the preview showed them.

templateRenameRequest.title: Template Rename Request
templateRenameRequest.description: Gives a saved team another name, keeping when it was saved, and records no event. A new slug another template holds is refused with template_exists at /name; a ready-made team's name with template_builtin at /name. Answers templateSlugResult.

slug.description: The saved team's file name without .yaml, as templates.list answers it.

name.description: The saved team's name, as the person typed it; the daemon trims it.

templateDeleteRequest.title: Template Delete Request
templateDeleteRequest.description: Removes a saved team's file, readable or not, and records no event. Answers emptyResult.

slug.description: The saved team's file name without .yaml, as templates.list answers it.

folder.description: The folder the daemon keeps saved teams in, as it uses it: under XDG_CONFIG_HOME when that is set. Null when Catervas has no state folder, in which case templates and unreadable are empty and the ready-made teams are still listed.

builtin.description: The ready-made teams Catervas comes with, in the order to list them. A saved file under one of their slugs is listed under unreadable, so it can be deleted; template.preview and template.apply by that slug reach the ready-made team.

template.description: The template whole, as team-template.schema.json shapes it.
The template whole, as team-template.schema.json shapes it.

unreadable.description: The files that are not a template, by slug.

templateAppliedResult.description: template.preview's answer, and template.apply's as applied.

digest.description: The sha256 of the template file's bytes as this answer read them, in lowercase hex; template.apply is given it.

team.description: The team as it would be, or is, as team.schema.json shapes it.

retired.description: Agents that have worked and are retired, by id.

removed.description: Agents that never worked and leave the file, by id.

added.description: Agents that join, by the id each gets.

effects.description: Each effect on the agents that stay and on the team's answers, in plain words.

errors.description: Why the result is not a team; empty when it is.

slug.description: The file name the template is kept under.
